title: Geometric regularity of the generic fibre over a complete local domain
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] local domain, and let $B$ be a Noetherian local $A$-algebra whose structure map is local. Suppose $A$ and $B$ are complete for their maximal-ideal-adic topologies [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], and $B$ is formally smooth over $A$ for its maximal-ideal-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Let $K$ be a fraction field of $A$ (the field obtained by localizing at the nonzero elements). Then $K\otimes_A B$ [def-weil-module-base-change] is Noetherian and geometrically regular over $K$ [def-weil-pbc-g-ring].

source.place: More on Algebra, Proposition Tag 07PM (proposition-fs-regular, line 12028), implication (4) => (1), and its proof (Proposition 07NQ fs-flat-fibre-fs; Algebra Lemma 032D complete-local-Noetherian-domain-finite-over-regular; Lemmas find-D, descent-fs, lift-derivation-through-fs, degree-p-extension-regular)

proof.text: Choose the regular complete coefficient subring A0 using 032D. Install completeness, finiteness and regular locality. Its maximal ideal is the pullback of m_A, which makes the inclusion local. The supplied quotient equivalence agrees on representatives with IsLocalRing.ResidueField.map, so that map is bijective.

Apply the existing formallySmoothAdic_tensorProduct base-change theorem along A -> A/m_A. Mathlib quotIdealMapEquivTensorQuot, extended to residue-field scalars, identifies B/m_A B with this tensor product. Transport formal smoothness along the inverse algebra equivalence: precompose the lifting problem, map the ideal powers, lift, and compose back. Ideal.map_map and the inverse equivalence on b tensor 1 identify the transported ideal with the image of m_B. Obtain flatness from 07NQ. Apply the finite coefficient lifting lemma to get C, a local adically formally smooth A0 -> C, a local map C -> B, and a bijective F : C tensor_A0 A -> B with F(c tensor a) = psi(c) phi(a).

Put K0 = FractionRing A0. The inclusion A0 -> A -> K is injective, so FractionRing.liftAlgebra gives K0 -> K with its scalar tower. Finiteness of A over A0 and Mathlib Algebra.IsAlgebraic localization of its fraction field make K a localization at images of nonzero A0; Module.Finite.of_isLocalization makes K finite over K0. The representative formula for F makes its bijective ring map into an A-algebra equivalence.
The fibre K tensor_A B is Noetherian, by localization base change and the localization Noetherian theorem, followed by tensor commutativity.

For each finite purely inseparable L/K, compose its A, A0 and K0 actions through the established towers. Module.Finite.trans gives finite L/K0. Apply the regular complete coefficient-domain finite-field theorem to C over A0, giving regularity of L tensor_A0 C. Tensor cancellation, congruence with the A-algebra equivalence F, tensor commutativity over A0 and a second cancellation identify L tensor_K (K tensor_A B) with L tensor_A0 C. Transport regularity. Together with Noetherianity this is exactly geometric regularity of the original generic fibre.
